caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur with a large, prominent rowel—star-shaped and featuring multiple pointed spokes—attached to the heel band of the spur. The rowel is metal with a dark, weathered brownish-gray color and slight gradients, giving a sense of its metallic nature. Three small teardrop-shaped pendants hang from the rowel’s axis. The body of the spur, including the arm and heel band, appears to be made of metal with a mixture of dark brown and gold tones, possibly indicating ornamentation or patina. The spur is rendered with detailed shading and texture, emphasizing the metallic surface and the joints where various pieces connect. The background is plain off-white, with ample blank space around the spur, centering it in the composition. The artist’s signature, “George Catlin,” is visible near the center-bottom of the image.
title: Spur
